decisionsTitle: «Kituri de pregătit» says how many volunteers have a kit and how many do not
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11:** «Aici trebuie sa zic clar cati voluntari cu kit am si cati fara kit».

**Amends** «Kituri de pregătit» (the block under the registrations list's counts, whose title already adds «+ N voluntari») and §904 (the organizers' own «Are kit» tick, `event_volunteers.has_kit`, and the «Voluntari» list's `?kit=yes|no`).

**Decision.** Under the runners' line the block draws one line for the volunteers, in the same style: «Voluntari: 11 cu kit · 23 fără kit.» Who is counted is one rule read once, in one grouped query by state and tick (`readVolunteerKitFigures`): «cu kit» is the volunteers in «Înscris» or «Confirmat» ticked «Are kit» — exactly the number the headline adds, passed to the block once; «fără kit» is the volunteers in «Înscris» or «Confirmat» not ticked; a cancelled volunteer («Anulat») is handed nothing and is in neither number, and the closing sentence «Cei anulați nu intră.» is drawn only when the event has one. The line is not drawn when the event has no volunteer counted at all; with volunteers and no tick it says «0 cu kit · 12 fără kit». The headline, the runners' line and `countKits` are unchanged; the race plan and the strip keep their own reads.

**Links.** Each number links to the «Voluntari» list for this event with `kit=yes` or `kit=no` — only where the list shows exactly that many people. The list has one state filter, so: when no cancelled volunteer carries that tick, the kit filter alone; when one does and one active state is left, the kit filter plus `state=` that state; when both active states and a cancelled one share the tick, the number is drawn without a link rather than a link that disagrees with it. The screens of the block and of the list have the same roles (`canManageVolunteers` is `canReadRegistrations`), so whoever sees the line may follow its links and nobody sees anything new.

**Decided without the owner:** the cancelled are left out of «fără kit» too (nobody hands them a kit); no line for an event whose only volunteers are cancelled; the words are plain, invariable phrases («{count} cu kit», «{count} fără kit»), so no count forms are needed. No migration, no dependency, no legal text.
changelogLine: - **Volunteers with and without a kit in «Kituri de pregătit»** — one line under the runners', «Voluntari: 11 cu kit · 23 fără kit.», each number a link to the «Voluntari» list when the list shows exactly that many, the cancelled left out and said so. §NNN.
